In detail

Piazzale Michelangelo is one of Florence's most-visited panoramic viewpoints, and local press has repeatedly reported thefts from tourists' parked cars in its car park over several years, with periodic arrests of the thieves and occasional recovery of stolen goods. This is a genuine, recurring, well-documented pattern, though it is property theft from vehicles rather than violent crime against people, and the piazzale itself remains a busy, well-frequented spot. Sources checked: FirenzeToday, 'Piazzale Michelangelo: ancora furti su auto'; 055firenze.it, arrest for theft from car at Piazzale Michelangelo; FirenzeToday, tourists robbed near Piazzale Michelangelo, thieves arrested.
